Do many Surrey homes under $1.8M include basement suites?

Yes. Detached homes across Newton, Fleetwood, Guildford, North Surrey, and Cloverdale frequently include 1- or 2-bedroom basement suites, and Clayton Heights properties often combine a basement suite with a detached rear lane coach house.
How do I check if a secondary suite is authorized by the City of Surrey?
Review the City of Surrey property records and annual municipal utility bill to verify whether a secondary suite permit was finalized and whether secondary-suite utility fees are registered on title.
How does BC Bill 44 (SSMUH) affect single-family lots under $1.8M in Surrey?

Provincial Small-Scale Multi-Unit Housing rules require municipalities to permit 3 to 4 units on standard urban single-family lots (and up to 6 units on qualifying lots near frequent transit stops), subject to City of Surrey zoning bylaws, servicing capacity, and tree regulations.
What lot sizes are typical for Surrey houses under $1.8M?

Established subdivisions in North Surrey, Guildford, Fleetwood, and Newton typically sit on 60-by-100-foot to 66-by-120-foot lots (6,000–7,920 sq ft), while newer compact subdivisions in Clayton, Sullivan, and Grandview Heights typically sit on 3,000 to 4,500 sq ft lots.
How do property prices under $1.8M differ between North Surrey and South Surrey?

, buyers typically find ranchers, older two-storey homes, or compact-lot houses in Grandview/Morgan Heights, whereas in North Surrey, Newton, and Fleetwood, the same budget often buys a larger 2,500–3,600 sq ft home on a full 6,000–7,200 sq ft lot.
